title: Telomere Maintenance and Gene Amplification in Yeast
summary: This cluster revolves around telomere maintenance and gene amplification in yeast. Telomerase, a gene involved in telomere maintenance, is mutated in ARS228. Telomeres are recognized by exonucleases and repaired by DNA repair. Gene amplification, a process involving Telomere, is also related to SUL1, which amplifies chr II and is amplified by Rad52, pol32, and yku70. The SUL1 locus is amplified on chr II, which has an amplicon junction with yku70Δ. Telomeres are involved in mmBIR, a method that requires pol32 and yku70. The cluster also includes various yeast organisms, such as BY4741 and FY4, and their relationships, including BY4741 being a close relative of FY4.
